status: Reviewable compile-only interface request; not implemented, frozen, sampled or qualified.

question: Can the guarded three-read stamp be placed at the original cfg_b FIRST/MAIN sites without changing work/synchronization, spilling, or losing its control chain?
requested_next_action: Target CUDA12.9 CPU-only build and actual CUTLASS source/SASS/resource audit. No GPU allocation, correctness run, pilot, formal sampling or new holdout is requested by this document.

predecessor.status: r4 corrects target grid dimensions from authoritative static setups; mechanism plan remains unfrozen/deferred pending observation validity
predecessor.unchanged_decisions: Original128ns total-window allowance,3200ns duration gate and all reproduction/perturbation/qualification limits remain unchanged; spatial qualification is unresolved. This request does not authorize the deferred30-process mechanism study.

candidate.zero_behavior: Before CLOCK and GT each retry at most once; exhaustion returns all zero. A zero final CLOCK is also invalid to the reader.
candidate.limits: Local CUDA13 isolated device-C++/PTX/SASS evidence only; target12.9/full-frame/hardware sampling enclosure unqualified.

layout.preserve: All original16 head words and original tile0..9 meanings remain. Only fields10/11 are new. Existing6/10-word protocols and original runs remain unchanged.

arms.device_observation: No timestamp trace writes. Allocate and prepare the same1552 words/CTA; call.trace remains empty.

Original CLOCK→GT pairs at FIRST/MAIN/PERMIT/DONE; at FIRST/MAIN additionally store zero in the matching field10/11, without an extra CLOCK read. This is a new matched baseline, not byte-identical old dual.
At original FIRST/MAIN, call candidate once and store before/GT/after in original fields plus10/11. PERMIT/DONE,entry,producer,final keep their original semantics.

placement.threads: Original role0/thread128 and role1/thread256 only, after the existing thread%128==0 and thread>=128 guard.
placement.sites: Only original v06_stamp FIRST and MAIN locations; do not add or move calls in the work loop.
placement.work: All132CTA must retain their original two outputs, one per original consumer role; full scheduled work covers264 tiles. No semantic work, WGMMA, release, wait, commit, barrier generation, output completion or synchronization changes.
placement.stores: Matched-dual and bracket write the same logical record fields at the same sites. Audit actual stores and register lifetimes; do not infer matching SASS from source store counts.

history.within_process: Each arm process constructs all handles/allocations before prefix, then runs16 calls of the same independently compiled plain module followed by its target, on the same A/B/D pointers within that process.
history.across_processes: Compare declared input contents, dimensions,strides,allocation sizes,initialization and prefix module/kernel identities. Absolute pointer equality or the same physical pages across distinct processes is not claimed.
history.preparation: All three arms clear1638912 trace bytes and synchronize before every prefix/target, in the same order; no per-arm extra scratch/preparation is silently introduced. Preserve all16 inter-call gaps and define any gap policy before later sampling.
history.metadata: setup/call both bind plain_prefix_protocol,ABI,preparation,clear_bytes,module/kernel/binary identity and same-buffers. The old warmup_policy label alone is insufficient.
history.wording_correction: Clarifies r4 ambiguous same-process wording: prefix and target share a process within each arm. It does not require three separately compiled arm targets to share one process or physical buffers.

reader_obligations.identity: A future case,setup and call must explicitly agree on r09_clock_observer_protocol=r09-clock-observer/v1 and arm kind. Require corresponding trace_version,tile_words12,trace_words1552,scratch1638912 and original config/stages/grid. Bind complete source/binary/header SHA through the existing freeze/build/process-record chain; do not add device-side hashing or require stdout to calculate hashes. Do not accept these as ordinary dual10 records.
reader_obligations.guarded_stamps: Each FIRST/MAIN stamp must contain three positive native uint64 integers, rejecting bool,float,zero,overflow or after<before. Require both original roles of all132CTAs, original work coordinates/counts and same-SM endpoints. Preserve invalid rows/reasons; no fallback to unbracketed dual.
reader_obligations.matched_baseline: Both added fields must be exactly zero; original dual endpoints,work/SM and metadata checks remain required.
reader_obligations.plain: No device trace; same host preparation identity and allocation bytes are required.
reader_obligations.math: Only after record validity use r09_clock_brackets.common_rate_interval.128ns is TOTAL window-difference allowance, not per endpoint. No phase price or target W/f is fitted.

cpu_acceptance: Compile actual cfg_b stage6 plain,matched_dual,guarded_bracket using target CUDA12.9, CUTLASS v3.9.2 and recorded public overlay/source identity; no CUDA runtime queries or device launches in this phase.
Record binary/SASS hashes,registers,SMEM,stack,spill,barriers and occupancy inputs; unexpected spill or loss of the original resident/work organization rejects this candidate build.
Audit actual FIRST/MAIN placement and active thread masks; both halves of each preceding read must control a real branch before the next read. CS2R plus SEL alone is rejected.
Audit finite retry initialization/bounds and zero-output exit; distinct inline sites must resolve their own scoped labels.
Verify original WGMMA/release/wait/commit/barrier and output-boundary source calls unchanged; check emitted instructions around both sites.
Review trace12 layout,matching host scratch/preparation and explicit parser identity/refusal paths before any future correctness or timing proposal.
after_cpu_acceptance: Main integration decides next correctness/observer qualification work. CPU pass alone neither permits30-process execution nor resolves spatial perturbation/hardware-enclosure questions.
